candidates.why: In MATCH_TYPE (non-PCRE2_16 branch), text is reassigned to a new malloc via bit_convert_TU at line 320, then do_match is called at line 321 with is16=(version>=R_2007). do_match calls print_match (lines 191/232/243/253), which frees text at line 166 when is16. Back in the macro, lines 323-324 free the same text pointer again -> double free / use-after-free.

common_entity frees color at line 214 only when *color=='#', but output_TEXT calls entity_color() inline at line 268 inside printf and never frees it; conversely the same entity_color() malloc'd string is freed in common_entity at 214 while other call sites (e.g. line 268) treat it as owned. Inconsistent ownership of the malloc'd color string returned by entity_color (lines 170/176) is a use-after-free/double-free risk across call sites.

In output_POLYLINE_2D, pts is malloc'd at line 573 but the early return at line 577 (error/isnan) skips free(pts) at line 599; similarly output_LWPOLYLINE allocates pts at 616 and returns at 620 before free at 642. This is a leak rather than UAF, but the same pts buffer is used at 587-588 after the guard, so ownership handling around the early-return is suspicious.
